assumptions.description: Generate independent synthetic rows, all task variables, exactly task n and allowed age range; IDs/order are implementation choices, not observed participants.
Conditional multivariate lognormal family on positive raw-scale measurements; two-component finite mixture. Shape is an assumption; all polynomial moments finite.
Uniform integer age 35-74; no target age composition supplied. Independent of female and latent component.
Transfer Changfeng sex count ratio to target; sex independent of age and latent component although source sex composition varies by age.
All conditional female offsets are fixed to zero as a simplifying unsupported assumption. Missing contrast evidence does not establish zero.
Transfer S1 total means at total mean age; use between-group ecological secants as individual conditional age trends, extrapolating to 35-44. These are not reported person-level slopes.
Transfer S1 total individual SDs to constant within-age/sex/background SDs even though totals include between-age variation and people >=75.

Raw-scale conditional BMI-glucose .20 and BMI-HbA1c .15, including positive signs, are author assumptions. S4 magnitude-only partial R-squared supplies loose heterogeneous context, not Chinese parameter estimates.

Transfer S2 unadjusted Pearson glucose-HbA1c r=.619 to constructed background law under a different age distribution/S1 marginals. Remove constructed age covariance algebraically. Not source-population replay.
Use 360/(360+4886) as latent known-diabetes weight proxy; not a reported prevalence or target estimate. Weight independent of age/sex.

Use newly OGTT-detected, untreated S2 subgroup distribution as provisional surrogate for previously known/treated diabetes. Treatment, duration, extremes and source-to-target population changes remain unidentified.
Fit lognormal to reported median and IQR ratio, not all three quantiles; use no age/sex shift and same conditional correlation matrix in known surrogate. These are assumptions.

Identity mapping of published units and source fasting plasma glucose/HPLC HbA1c to task central-serum glucose/whole-blood HbA1c. Assay, fasting and matrix equivalence are not established; no numerical conversion invented.

Selected Chinese and non-Chinese source populations do not establish target complete-case distribution. No clinical exclusions, medication, pregnancy, anemia, kidney disease or clustering effects modeled.

All computable checks compare a whole generated task population to selected-source marginal statistics approximately. They are not exact latent-component checks, source-population replay, target validity or a loss function.
No meta-analytic weighting or independence precision gain. Shanghai individual overlap unknown; Bao diagnostic groups and FOS subsets overlap.
Individual residual variation is distinct from unreported estimator precision, evidence uncertainty and model/transport uncertainty. No confidence weights or fabricated source CI/SE.

background_reference_age.derivation: Reported total mean age 63.1, used as transferred conditional mean anchor.

background_means_at_reference_age.derivation: Reported source arithmetic means used at reference age under ecological-to-individual transfer.

background_age_slopes.derivation: Per-variable (65-74 group mean minus 45-54 group mean)/(69.7-51.9); ecological slopes, not reported regressions.

background_conditional_sds.derivation: Reported total individual SD values transplanted to constant conditional SD; no SE substitution.

conditional_female_offsets.derivation: Exactly zero conditional effects by explicit author assumption; not inferred from absence of evidence.

conditional_raw_correlation_matrix.derivation: Diagonal 1. BMI correlations .20/.15 assumed. GH=(.619*sqrt((1.07^2+bG^2*133.25)*(.63^2+bH^2*133.25))-bG*bH*133.25)/(1.07*.63)=.6122036085261267. Same raw matrix in both components by assumption. S4 R2 only loose magnitude context.

known_component_arithmetic_means.derivation: BMI reported arithmetic 25.5/3.7. For G/H sigma_log=log(Q75/Q25)/(2*0.6744897501960817); arithmetic m=median*exp(sigma_log^2/2), s=m*sqrt(exp(sigma_log^2)-1). Conditional independent of age; numerical parameters derived, not reported means/SDs. Implied quartiles approximate.
